title: Federated Art Chase: Privacy Leakage and Data Poisoning in Federated Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2610.21547v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated learning (FL) is increasingly used to adapt a pretrained, centrally fine-tuned model to data that remain on user devices, beyond training a model from scratch. In this report, prepared for the 4th Federated Machine Learning International Summer School, we study the privacy and integrity of this approach with a reproducible pipeline. An ImageNet-pretrained MobileNetV4-Conv-Small model is fine-tuned centrally on ten Quick, Draw! classes (97.50% test accuracy) and then adapted with head-only FedAvg over ten non-IID clients, which raises client training accuracy from 90.34% to 91.49% while preserving global accuracy. We evaluate four adversarial scenarios. First, from a single one-step client update, an honest-but-curious server recovers the complete private label set, but its reconstructions follow class prototypes rather than the private drawings (mean SSIM 0.130). translated_title: 联邦艺术追踪：联邦微调中的隐私泄露与数据投毒
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.21547v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：联邦学习（FL）正越来越多地被用于将一个预先训练、集中微调过的模型适配到保留在用户设备上的数据，而不仅限于从头训练模型。在本为第四届联邦机器学习国际暑期学校准备的报告中，我们通过一个可复现的实验流程研究了该方法的隐私性与完整性。一个在ImageNet上预训练的MobileNetV4-Conv-Small模型先在十个Quick, Draw!绘画类别上进行集中微调（测试准确率达97.50%），随后通过仅训练头部的FedAvg在十个非IID客户端上进行适配，使客户端训练准确率从90.34%提升至91.49%，同时保持全局准确率。我们评估了四种对抗场景：第一，从一个单步客户端更新中，诚实但好奇的服务器能够恢复完整的私有标签集合，但其重建结果遵循的是类原型而非私有的绘画样本（平均SSIM仅为0.130）；第二，从一轮FedAvg聚合中，标签数量恢复……
tldr: 该论文通过一个可复现的实验流程，系统评估了联邦微调在非IID场景下的安全威胁，表明诚实但好奇的服务器可从单步客户端更新中恢复完整私有标签集，并揭示了联邦微调中的隐私泄露与数据投毒风险。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a reproducible pipeline that systematically evaluates privacy leakage and data poisoning threats in federated fine-tuning, showing that an honest-but-curious server can recover the complete private label set from a single one-step client update.
